content: Chatwoot Community Edition (MIT, self-hosted) includes WhatsApp Cloud API, email/IMAP channels, website widget, Telegram/IG/FB, canned responses, labels, custom attributes, automation rules, reports, CSAT, Dashboard Apps, and webhooks. Enterprise Edition (proprietary, paid) adds SLA management, custom dashboards, agent capacity management, whitelabeling, SSO, IP allowlisting, audit logs; Captain AI/voice gated behind Premium Support tier. For a 1-3 operator single-VPS deployment, CE covers all v4.0 requirements; EE not needed.
